P.name: Hextech Affinity
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Heimerdinger''' gains {{sti|ms|{{as|20% '''bonus''' movement speed}}}} while near an allied {{tip|turret}} or a ''{{ai|H-28G Evolution Turret|Heimerdinger}}'' or ''{{ai|H-28Q Apex Turret|Heimerdinger}}'' deployed by him.

Q.name: H-28G Evolution Turret
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Heimerdinger''' deploys a ''H-28G Evolution Turret'' at the target location, which lasts until destroyed.
Q.description2: '''Heimerdinger''' periodically [[stocks]] a ''Turret Kit'' charge, up to a maximum of 3.
Q.description3: Up to 3 ''H-28G Evolution Turrets'' can be deployed at a time, with those deployed beyond the maximum destroying the oldest one.
Q.description4: ''See [[Heimerdinger#Pets|Pets]] for more details about H-28G Evolution Turrets.''

Q.name: H-28Q Apex Turret
Q.description: {{sbc|{{ai|UPGRADE!!!|Heimerdinger}} - Active:}} '''Heimerdinger''' deploys a ''H-28Q Apex Turret'' at the target location, which lasts for 8 seconds.
Q.description3: ''See [[Heimerdinger#Pets|Pets]] for more details about the H-28Q Apex Turret.''

W.name: Hextech Micro-Rockets
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Heimerdinger''' launches a wave of 5 rockets that converge upon the target location and fan beyond it up to a maximum range, with each one dealing {{as|magic damage}} to the first enemy it hits. Every rocket hitting an enemy {{tip|champion}} grants 20% beam charge to all ''{{ai|H-28G Evolution Turret|Heimerdinger|icononly=yes}} {{ai|H-28Q Apex Turret|Heimerdinger|turrets}}'' within 1000 range, up to a maximum of 100% beam charge when hitting 5 rockets on an enemy champion.
W.description2: Enemies can be hit by multiple rockets, but receive less damage from ones beyond the first. Against {{tip|minions}}, this lesser damage is increased by {{ap|(3.0-1)*100}}%.
W.leveling2:
{{st|Subsequent Rocket Magic Damage|{{ap|10 to 30}} {{as|(+ 12% AP)}}|Total Subsequent Non-Minion Damage|{{ap|4*10 to 4*30}} {{as|(+ {{ap|4*12}}% AP)}}|Combined Total Non-Minion Damage|{{ap|50+4*10 to 150+4*30}} {{as|(+ {{ap|55+4*12}}% AP)}}}}
{{st|Subsequent Rocket Minion Damage|{{ap|10*3.0 to 30*3.0}} {{as|(+ {{ap|12*3.0}}% AP)}}|Total Subsequent Minion Damage|{{ap|4*10*3.0 to 4*30*3.0}} {{as|(+ {{ap|4*12*3.0}}% AP)}}|Combined Total Minion Damage|{{ap|50+4*10*3.0 to 150+4*30*3.0}} {{as|(+ {{ap|55+4*12*3.0}}% AP)}}}}

W.name: Hextech Rocket Swarm
W.description: {{sbc|{{ai|UPGRADE!!!|Heimerdinger}} - Active:}} '''Heimerdinger''' unleashes 4 waves of 5 rockets in quick succession that converge upon the target location. Each rocket deals {{as|magic damage}} to the first enemy hit.
W.leveling:
{{sbc|''{{ai|Hextech Rocket Swarm|Heimerdinger}}'' scales with ''{{ais|UPGRADE!!!|Heimerdinger}}'' rank}}
{{st|Initial Rocket Damage|{{ap|135 to 225 3}} {{as|(+ 45% AP)}}}}
W.description2: Enemies can be hit by multiple rockets. {{tip|Champions}} and {{tip|monsters}} receive less damage from the second to fifth rockets that hit them, which is reduced by {{ap|0.5*100}}% for rockets beyond the fifth. {{tip|Minions}} instead always receive 100% of the initial damage from every single rocket.
W.leveling2:
{{st|Rockets 2–5 Magic Damage|{{ap|32 to 58 3}} {{as|(+ 12% AP)}}|Rockets 6–20 Magic Damage|{{ap|32*0.5 to 58*0.5 3}} {{as|(+ {{ap|12*0.5}}% AP)}}|Combined Total Non-Minion Damage|{{ap|135+4*32+15*32*0.5 to 225+4*58+15*58*0.5 3}} {{as|(+ {{ap|45+4*12+15*12*0.5}}% AP)}}}}
{{st|Minion Damage per Rocket|{{ap|135 to 225 3}} {{as|(+ 45% AP)}}|Combined Total Minion Damage|{{ap|20*135 to 20*225 3}} {{as|(+ {{ap|20*45}}% AP)}}}}

E.name: CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Heimerdinger''' hurls a grenade at the target location that detonates upon impact, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies and {{tip|slow|slowing}} them by 35% for 2 seconds. If the grenade hits an enemy {{tip|champion}}, all ''{{ai|H-28G Evolution Turret|Heimerdinger|icononly=yes}} {{ai|H-28Q Apex Turret|Heimerdinger|turrets}}'' within 1000 range of the impact gain 100% beam charge.
E.description2: Enemies hit at the center of the grenade's impact are also {{tip|stun|stunned}} for {{fd|1.5}} seconds.

E.name: CH-3X Lightning Grenade
E.description: {{sbc|{{ai|UPGRADE!!!|Heimerdinger}} - Active:}} '''Heimerdinger''' hurls a massive grenade at the target location that bounces {{tt|a fixed distance|300 range per bounce, 600 in total}} 3 times in the cast direction. The grenade explodes upon landing each time to deal {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies and {{tip|slow}} them by 35% for 2 seconds. Enemies hit at the center of the grenade's impact are additionally {{tip|stun|stunned}} for {{fd|1.5}} seconds.
E.leveling:
{{sbc|''{{ai|CH-3X Lightning Grenade|Heimerdinger}}'' scales with ''{{ais|UPGRADE!!!|Heimerdinger}}'' rank}}
{{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|100 to 300 3}} {{as|(+ 60% AP)}}}}
E.description2: Enemy champions can only be damaged once per cast, but can be {{tip|slow|slowed}} and {{tip|stun|stunned}} multiple times if circumstances permit.

R.name: UPGRADE!!!
R.description: {{sbc|Toggle:}} '''Heimerdinger''' empowers his next [[champion ability|basic ability]] for an additional effect, consuming the empowerment upon cast and placing ''UPGRADE!!!'' on full cooldown. These empowered abilities have the same cooldowns as their basic forms, deal modified damage, and do not have a {{sti|{{as|mana}}}} cost.
R.description2: ''UPGRADE!!!'' incurs its static cooldown on-cast, and can be toggled off to remove the empowerment and place the ability on its static {{sti|cooldown}}.
R.description3: ''UPGRADE!!! can be used while affected by {{tip|cast-inhibiting crowd control}}.''
